title: Toddler Boy Sitting on Brick Garden Steps, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot capturing a young toddler boy seated outdoors on low brick garden steps adjacent to a concrete walkway. Dressed in a light short-sleeved t-shirt, shorts, and dark shoes with laces, he gazes toward the camera with an earnest expression. Lush foliage frames the right side, while a light flare washes over the left background where another person is partially visible sitting on a porch. The composition reflects mid-century everyday domestic family life.
